Recurrence quantification for a complete 2D or 3D fish path

Source: R/trajectory-shape.R
aqt_trajectory_recurrence.Rd

Euclidean position recurrence within a declared physical/pixel radius. Excludes diagonal and short-temporal separations by a Theiler window. Reports recurrence rate, diagonal-line determinism and vertical-line laminarity. These are descriptive measures whose interpretation depends on radius, sampling rate, tracking quality and tank geometry.

Usage

aqt_trajectory_recurrence(
  track,
  radius,
  theiler = 1L,
  min_diagonal = 2L,
  min_vertical = 2L,
  max_gap_s = Inf,
  store_matrix = FALSE
)

Arguments

track

One validated scoped fish trajectory, with no missing samples.

radius

Nonnegative recurrence distance in coordinate units.

theiler

Exclude pair indices at |i-j| <= this integer (default 1).

min_diagonal

Minimum diagonal recurrence run length >= 2.

min_vertical

Minimum vertical recurrence run length >= 2.

max_gap_s

Largest permitted inter-observation gap.

store_matrix

Return logical recurrence matrix for visualization.

Value

Descriptive RQA diagnostics, optionally the recurrence matrix.
